choices.question: Which live GitHub contexts must be qualified before the alpha? I recommend personal public repositories first, with controlled tests for organization/private-repo constraints and missing access. Other supported setups remain usable through current research and native tools, with evidence limits stated.

scope: Organization and private-repository contexts require live qualification before alpha, alongside personal/public contexts. Exact representative fixtures, plans, permissions, and evidence belong to the qualification contract; no full Cartesian matrix or live experiments are silently authorized by this design answer.
